info.title: FsLiveDocs
info.description: Verified, semantic, version-aware documentation for F#.

options.name: --theme
options.description:
Set the site theme for build, build-history, or watch
(default: light).

options.name: --version
options.description:
Set the documentation version for build, extract,
capture, or watch.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Set the output path for extract, capture, or
history-add.

options.name: --capsule
options.description:
With history-add, read the release capsule from a
local path.

options.name: --url
options.description:
With history-add, download the release capsule from
an HTTPS URL.

options.name: --sha256
options.description: With history-add --url, require this capsule SHA-256.

options.name: --host
options.description: Set the watch preview's bind host (default: 0.0.0.0).

options.name: --ignore
options.description:
With watch, ignore these comma-separated directory
names. Repeatable.

options.name: --warn-as-error
options.description:
Make API documentation quality warnings fail audit,
test, build, capture, or watch.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description:
Set console verbosity: warnings (default), info, or
debug.

options.name: --interactive
options.description:
Enable or disable interactive terminal rendering
(default: true).

options.name: --banner
options.description: Enable or disable the LiveDocs banner (default: true).

options.name: --discover-projects
options.description:
With init, discover project files and save them in
.livedocs/config.json.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
With capture, validate and report expected output
without writing a capsule.
